title: Raw bench press percentiles from OpenPowerlifting full-power meets, 2015 to 2026
description:
Percentile tables (10th, 25th, 50th, 75th, 90th) of the best raw bench press for adults who entered full-power powerlifting meets between 2015-01-01 and 2026-11-01, built from the 2026-11-07 release of the public OpenPowerlifting database. Tables are given by sex and IPF weight class (kg and lb), as a multiple of bodyweight by sex, and as a multiple of bodyweight by sex and age group.

Counts: 199,726 men and 99,528 women (distinct names) from 842,890 qualifying entries. Cells with fewer than 200 lifters are dropped.

The people in the data chose to compete, so the percentiles describe competitors and not the general gym-going population. Names are used to match lifters across meets, so two lifters with the same name are merged. The filters, counts and rebuild scripts are included.
